description: This Java interface defines the configuration contract for the Connectivity service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends multiple other configuration interfaces to aggregate various configuration aspects such as connection, reconnect behavior, client, monitoring, mapping, signal enrichment, and acknowledgement handling settings.

classes.name: ConnectivityConfig
classes.description: A Java interface for retrieving configuration settings of the Connectivity service, including connection, reconnection, client, monitoring, mapping, signal enrichment, and acknowledgement configurations.

methods.name: getConnectionConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object for establishing connections within the Connectivity service.

methods.name: getReconnectConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object that defines the reconnect behavior of the service.

methods.name: getClientConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for the Connectivity service's client.

methods.name: getMonitoringConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration related to monitoring features such as connection logs and metrics.

methods.name: getMappingConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for message mapping used in the Connectivity service.

methods.name: getSignalEnrichmentConfig
methods.description: Provides the configuration for signal enrichment processing.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration related to acknowledgement handling.
